acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
Mass spectra were acquired in data-dependent acquisition mode with a TOP15 method.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Immunoprecipitated proteins (from GFP trap enrichment) in 4M urea 50mM Tris-HCl pH 8.5, were reduced with dithiothreitol, alkylated with chloroacetamide, and digested with trypsin (1:100) o/n.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Immunoprecipitated proteins (from GFP trap enrichment) in 4M urea 50mM Tris-HCl pH 8.5, were reduced with dithiothreitol, alkylated with chloroacetamide, and digested with trypsin (1:100) o/n.

collision_energy.evidence: HCD fragmentation was performed at a normalized collision energy of 25.

enrichment_method.evidence: The rest of the supernatants were added to GFP-Trap magnetic beads.

fragmentation_method.evidence: HCD fragmentation was performed at a normalized collision energy of 25.

instrument.evidence: Samples were analysed using an EASY-nLC 1200 (Thermo Fisher) coupled to a Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher) or using an EASY-nLC 1000 (Thermo Fisher) coupled to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher), respectively.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: Peptides (0.5 µg) were loaded on the column and eluted for 115 min using a segmented linear gradient of 5% to 95% solvent B (0 min : 5%B; 0-5 min -> 5%B; 5-65 min -> 20%B; 65-90 min ->35%B; 90-100 min -> 55%; 100-105 min ->95%, 105-115 min ->95%) (solvent A 0% ACN, 0.1% FA; solvent B 80% ACN, 0.1%FA) at a flow rate of 300 nL/min.

labeling.evidence: quantification: MS1 intensity based label-free quantification method

Raw data were processed using MaxQuant software (version 1.6.3.4, http://www.maxquant.org/) {Cox et al., Nat. Biotechnol. 2008, 26, 1367.} with label-free quantification (LFQ) and iBAQ enabled {Cox et al., Nat. Protoc. 2016, 11, 2301.}.

mass_analyzer.evidence: MS spectra were acquired in the Orbitrap analyzer with a mass range of 300–1750 m/z at a resolution of 70,000 FWHM and a target value of 3×106 ions.
